identificationModule.briefTitle: Dalpiciclib Combined With Letrozole in Neoadjuvant Treatment of Stage Ⅱ-Ⅲ HR-positive/HER2-negative Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Exploratory Clinical Study of CDK4/6 Inhibitor Dalpiciclib Combined With Letrozole in Neoadjuvant Treatment of Stage Ⅱ-Ⅲ HR-positive/HER2-negative Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single-arm, open-label, exploratory clinical study
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-arm, open-label, exploratory clinical study initiated by the investigator to evaluate the objective response rate (ORR), efficacy, and safety of Dalpiciclib combined with letrozole in the neoadjuvant treatment of stage Ⅱ-Ⅲ HR+/HER2- breast cancer.

armGroups.label: Dalpiciclib+ letrozole
armGroups.description:
Dalpiciclib combined with Letrozole,28 days as one cycle.

1. Dalpiciclib: 150 mg (p.o.) was given once daily for 3 weeks, followed by 1 week off in each 4-week cycle.
2. Letrozole: 2.5mg, p.o., once a day, continuous administration.

interventions.name: Dalpiciclib
interventions.description:
An exploratory study of a single-arm, open design

All subjects enrolled will receive the following treatment:

Dalpiciclib combined with Letrozole, 28 days as one cycle.
